title: WorkflowTrace
description: One observed, content-addressed record of a single non-deterministic workflow decision step (an LLM call, a multi-LLM consensus, a heuristic, or a human/policy adjudication) and its VERIFICATION outcome. The Determinism Factory mines ONLY from traces whose final_decision is VERIFIED (adjudicated, source-grounded, receipt-backed) — never from raw/ungrounded LLM output. This is a META observation ledger over Baltor's existing deterministic authorities (reconciliation, optimizer, consumption gate); it does NOT itself decide truth. A trace pins: tenant + source_scope (a tenant_private trace can NEVER train a global rule), the workflow/step identity, the input/output artifacts consumed and produced, the model/provider/prompt_hash when an LLM was involved, all three validation gates (schema/grounding/deterministic), the final_decision, the source_handles that ground it, and the receipt_ids that warrant it. Deterministic when created_at is injected (no wall-clock, no RNG).

trace_id.description: content-addressed trace id (sha256 over identity+inputs+outputs+decision); deterministic, no clock/RNG

tenant_id.description: owning tenant; combined with source_scope this gates whether the trace may ever train a GLOBAL rule

source_scope.description: tenant_private traces can NEVER create a global rule unless anonymized + approved (enforced by mining + replay)

workflow_id.description: the workflow this decision belongs to (e.g. cfpb.reconcile, source.classify, optimize.reject)

step_id.description: the specific decision step within the workflow

decision_kind.description: what produced the proposed output at this step; truth is never decided by 'llm' or 'consensus' alone

input_artifact_ids.description: the artifacts consumed by this step; referenced, never overwritten

output_artifact_ids.description: the artifacts produced by this step

model_id.description: model identity, present when an LLM was involved

provider_id.description: model provider identity (routed via the single LLMGateway, never a direct provider bypass)

prompt_hash.description: hash of the prompt (handle, not the raw prompt — private prompts live in the object/tenant store); deterministic. Empty string allowed for non-LLM steps.

schema_validation.description: did the step output validate against its JSON schema

grounding_validation.description: is the output grounded in source handles (NOT an ungrounded summary / allegation-as-fact)

deterministic_validation.description: did Baltor's deterministic authority (reconciliation/conflict/policy) agree — this, not consensus, is the label source

final_decision.description: the VERIFIED outcome that was actually served / recorded (e.g. 'winner=reg-e-10day'); the label the factory may distill toward

verified.description: true ONLY when the decision is adjudicated + source-grounded + receipt-backed; the miner consumes ONLY verified=true traces

consensus_run_id.description: link to the ConsensusRun when decision_kind=consensus; the run is evidence, not the truth source

adjudication_record_id.description: link to the AdjudicationRecord that produced the verified label, when one exists

source_handles.description: ctx:// handles grounding the decision; a verified trace without source handles is not mineable

receipt_ids.description: verification/adjudication/promotion receipt ids that warrant this trace; proof handles, never erased

reversed_later.description: true if this decision was later corrected/reversed; reversed conflicts are NEVER mined as truth

stale.description: true if the grounding fact is now stale; stale facts are NEVER mined as truth

created_at.description: injected time; the trace is deterministic when this is injected
